rule.name: BITS Job Persistence
rule.description:
The following analytic detects BITSAdmin configuring a non-NULL notification program with /SetNotifyCmdLine.
Adversaries can use a BITS job callback to execute a payload when a transfer completes or enters an error state and retain execution across sessions.
rule.query:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly`
  count min(_time) as firstTime
        max(_time) as lastTime

FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE

`process_bitsadmin`
Processes.process="*/setnotifycmdline*"

BY Processes.action Processes.dest Processes.original_file_name
   Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_exec Processes.parent_process_guid
   Processes.parent_process_id Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path
   Processes.process Processes.process_exec Processes.process_guid
   Processes.process_hash Processes.process_id Processes.process_integrity_level
   Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.user
   Processes.user_id Processes.vendor_product

| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`

| rex field=process "(?i)(?:^|\s)/setnotifycmdline[ \t]+(?<bits_job>\"[^\"]*\"|[^\s\"]+)[ \t]+(?<bits_notify_program>\"[^\"]*\"|[^\s\"]+)(?:[ \t]+(?<bits_notify_parameters>[^\r\n]*))?$"

| where isnotnull(bits_notify_program)
        AND
        NOT match(bits_notify_program, "(?i)^(?:\"\"|\"?NULL\"?)$")

| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `bits_job_persistence_filter`
false_positives:
Legitimate applications and administrators can configure BITS notification programs.
Validate the callback program and job purpose and tune the filter macro using the program, parent process and account together.
Setting the callback to NULL clears it and is excluded. Custom headers and ordinary job management are not
included.
